title: Slack User token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: sections joined by "." instead of the documented "-" separator and boundary: underscore after the prefix (xoxp_ vs the documented dash-separated xoxp-). Twin of "Slack User token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-user-token-bearer-curl: boundary: underscore after the prefix (xoxp_ vs the documented dash-separated xoxp-). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
